description: Read-only captures of transactions mined on 25 November 2026, for Across transfers of the wrapped native token: one deposit a stranger sent to the Ethereum SpokePool with its amount as native value, with its receipt and the Base fill that paid its recipient the native asset; fills of the wrapped native token to plain recipients on Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and OP Mainnet, to a delegating plain account on Base and to a contract on Base; one execution of relayer refund roots on Base that paid the wrapped token to a depositor whose deposit was sent as native value, kept to the logs of the SpokePool and of the token; and two answers of the venue's quote API, one quote of the wrapped token from Ethereum to Base and one refusal of an amount as too low, each without its request identifier. Each recipient's code was read at the block of its fill, a contract's kept to its first 32 bytes, and its native balance one block before the fill and at it. Nothing here was sent by this repository.

body.message: Sent amount is too low relative to fees
